title: Totem Display
body:
# Totem Display — Never Miss Your Safety Net!

**Totem Display** is a lightweight, client-side cosmetic and utility mod for Fabric[cite: 1]. It adds a clean, customizable indicator to your heads-up display (HUD), showing you at a glance whether you have a **Totem of Undying** equipped or ready in your inventory[cite: 1]. 

No more opening your inventory mid-combat or panicking during intense PvP/PvE situations just to check if you are protected.

---

## ✨ Features

* **Real-Time Totem Tracking:** Displays a handy icon on your screen so you always know your survival status.
* **Fully Configurable:** Don't like where the icon is? The mod includes a built-in configuration screen to adjust the display to fit your personal UI preferences[cite: 1].
* **Seamless Mod Menu Integration:** Access the settings screen effortlessly directly from your in-game mod list[cite: 1].
* **100% Client-Side:** This mod runs entirely on your client[cite: 1]. You can join any vanilla multiplayer server, Realms, or anarchy server without needing the mod installed on the server side.

---

## 🛠 Technical Specifications & Requirements

| Detail | Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Mod Loader** | Fabric |
| **Supported Game Versions** | 1.21.4, 1.21.8, 1.21.11 |
| **Environment** | Client-side only |
| **Required Mods** | **Fabric API** |
| **Optional Mods** | **Mod Menu** *(Highly recommended to access the in-game config screen)*[cite: 1] |

---

## 💡 Why download Totem Display?

In Minecraft, a split second can mean the difference between keeping your hard-earned gear or losing everything. **Totem Display** gives you the peace of mind you need during raids, boss fights, or dangerous exploration by keeping your totem status visible at all times without cluttering your screen.
